Wild carrots probably evolved with the other flowering plants about 360 million years ago.
Like apples, carrots are native to Central Asia.
That's why horses, which also come from Central Asia, like both apples and carrots so much.
With wild carrots, the roots are white, small and skinny, so you'd have to pick a lot of wild carrots to get enough to eat.
Doctors used carrot seeds and roots as medicine, on the theory that foods that taste bad must be good for you.
But people still mostly fed carrots to horses, donkeys and pigs, and didn't eat them themselves.
The red color was popular for Chinese New Year celebrations.
Today, cooler countries grow most of the world's carrots.
Machines do most of the planting and picking, and carrots are easy to store and ship, so they are cheap almost everywhere.
With Facebook, she could stay connected with her family no matter how far away they were.
She could see their photos and read their status updates.
With Facebook, she could keep her relatives up-to-date on what she was doing.
Whenever she called her parents or other relatives, she always had to think about the time difference so that she wouldn't wake someone up or call when she knew they were at church.
At first, this didn't bother her.
She loved finding out people were getting married, having babies, and traveling.
She was also spending a lot of time on Facebook.
It took a lot of time and energy to keep up with everyone's status updates.
She looked at the list of over 500 friends she had on Facebook and realized some of them were not really friends at all.
Farmers and farm animal breeders would bring their animals to market every April to show, buy, and trade.
This was an important business before the days of tractors, when many families made a living from farming and mules were used as work animals.
Eventually, tractors began to replace mules, making them less in demand.
Over the years other activities have been added, and today more than 200,000 people show up each year to watch and participate.
